emission_layers.description: transformer emission only: number of attention layers. Ignored by the closed-form emissions.

emission_positional.description: transformer emission only: add positional encoding, letting the emission read FRAME INDEX as well as phase.

epochs.description: training epochs; one fresh window per song per epoch.

batch_size.description: windows per step, shared by training and evaluation.

lr.description: Adam learning rate for the single base parameter group.

clip.description: gradient-norm clip over the params the variant's optimizer hook hands back.

gsnn_alpha.description: Weight of the CVAE objective: zero trains only the sampled prior and learned decoder.

beta_end.description: KL weight after warmup; the reported elbo is always beta = 1.

beta_warmup.description: epochs to ramp beta linearly from beta_start to beta_end; 0 disables annealing.

excerpt_seconds.description: window length. Below ~45 s the ELBO cannot separate tracking the truth from coasting on a constant period (crop-horizon root cause).

prior_phase_kappa.description: concentration of the physical prior's increment law: the DRIFT TAX. Real tempo wobble is heavy-tailed, so lowering this cuts the KL price of expressing drift.

frontend.description: registered frontend name, such as beat_this or musicfm.

frontend_checkpoint.description: checkpoint path or frontend-specific checkpoint name; empty uses the frontend's own default. One checkpoint serves train/validation/test. MusicFM expects pretrained_msd.pt with msd_stats.json beside it.

frontend_lr_scale.description: multiplier on lr for the frontend's own parameters. 0 = frozen (the frontend runs under no_grad and only the VAE trains); > 0 thaws it and adds it as a second optimizer group at lr * this. RECONSTRUCTED 2026-08-11 after an accidental git checkout discarded the uncommitted original -- the semantics come from run.py's usage, the wording is not the author's.

clip_per_group.description: clip each parameter tensor against cfg.clip separately instead of one pooled norm (which one tensor dominated, throttling all others). Changes the log's |g|: pooled norm when false, largest single-tensor norm when true.

meters.description: beats-per-bar values the chain enumerates; at least one is required. Meter joins rate in the state and may change only at a wrapping phase transition.

prior_dim.description: Audio-only prior encoder width (multiple of four).

log_velocity.description: Use a positive physical velocity via velocity_ref * exp(latent).

velocity_ref.description: Reference radians per frame for log velocity; 120 BPM in 4/4 at 50 Hz.

meter_gated.description: Allow learned meter transitions only when the bar pointer crosses a downbeat.
